subject: App Crash Report — iPhone 15 iOS 17.4
body:
Hi Support,

I'm experiencing repeated crashes on iPhone 15 running iOS 17.4, app version 3.1.0.

Steps:
1. Open app
2. Go to Settings tab
3. Tap 'Account Details'
4. App crashes immediately

Device: iPhone 15 | OS: iOS 17.4 | App: 3.1.0

Please fix ASAP.
John

subject: Login Issue Since v3.0.1 Update
body:
Hello,

Since v3.0.1 I cannot log in. Enter credentials, spinner appears for 5 seconds then vanishes — not logged in.

Device: Samsung Galaxy S22 | OS: Android 13 | App: 3.0.1

Steps:
1. Open app
2. Enter valid credentials
3. Tap Sign In
4. Spinner vanishes — not logged in

Tried password reset — same issue.

subject: Data Loss Problem — Urgent
body:
URGENT — Lost 3 weeks of data after the 3.0.5 update. All notes/task history before March 2024 are gone. History tab shows empty state.

Device: Google Pixel 7 | OS: Android 14 | App: 3.0.5

Steps:
1. Update to 3.0.5
2. Open app
3. Navigate to History
4. All previous entries gone

Critical — need that data for work.

subject: Notification Bug — Not Receiving Alerts
body:
Hi,

Push notifications stopped working after iOS 17.1 upgrade.

Device: iPhone 14 Pro | OS: iOS 17.1 | App: 3.1.0

Steps:
1. Enable notifications in app and iOS Settings
2. Set reminder 5 minutes from now
3. Wait — no notification arrives

Tried toggling permissions. No improvement.
Sarah

subject: Sync Failure Between iPad and iPhone
body:
Hello Support,

Data not syncing between iPhone and iPad. Create item on iPhone — never appears on iPad after 30 minutes.

iPhone 13, iOS 16.6, App v3.0.5
iPad Pro, iPadOS 16.6, App v3.0.5

Steps:
1. Create task on iPhone
2. Open iPad (same account)
3. Task missing
4. Pull to refresh — still missing

Both on same WiFi.

subject: App Freezes on Android 14 — Galaxy S23
body:
Hi,

App freezes completely on Galaxy S23 running Android 14.

Device: Samsung Galaxy S23 | OS: Android 14 | App: 3.1.0

Steps:
1. Open app
2. Go to Dashboard
3. Scroll down rapidly
4. App becomes unresponsive — must force-kill

Clearing cache does not help.

subject: Search Not Returning Results
body:
Hi,

Search completely broken. Type exact phrases that are in my notes — get zero results.

Device: OnePlus 10 Pro | OS: Android 13 | App: 3.0.5

Steps:
1. Navigate to Search
2. Type 'meeting notes'
3. Results: 'No items found' (I have 20 notes with that phrase)

Please help.

subject: Crash When Uploading Large Files
body:
Hello,

App crashes uploading files >10MB.

Device: iPhone 13 Pro | OS: iOS 16.6 | App: 3.0.1

Steps:
1. Tap '+' to add attachment
2. Select 15MB PDF from Files
3. Upload progress bar appears
4. At ~60% progress, app crashes

Consistent across multiple files and network conditions.
Tom

subject: Two-Factor Authentication Not Working
body:
Hi Support,

2FA SMS codes not delivered. Cannot log in at all.

Device: Samsung Galaxy A52 | OS: Android 12 | App: 3.0.5

Steps:
1. Open app
2. Enter email + password
3. 2FA screen appears — wait for SMS
4. SMS never arrives (checked spam, tried resend 5×)

This is a blocker — cannot access account.
David

subject: Widget Crashes Home Screen
body:
Hello,

Home screen widget crashes launcher when I try to add it.

Device: Pixel 7a | OS: Android 14 | App: 3.1.0

Steps:
1. Long press home screen
2. Select Widgets
3. Find app widget
4. Drag to home screen — launcher crashes

Every time.

subject: Subscription Price Too High
body:
Hello,

The recent price increase to $15/month is too much. Competitors charge $5-8/month for more features. Considering cancelling.

Thanks

subject: Very Slow App Performance
body:
Hi,

The app has become extremely slow. Dashboard takes 8-10 seconds to load, switching tabs takes 3-4 seconds. Considering switching to a competitor.

Frustrated

subject: Poor Customer Support Experience
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

Submitted a ticket 2 weeks ago about a billing issue and received only one automated response. I am a premium subscriber and this level of support is unacceptable.

Disappointed

subject: Too Many Ads in Free Tier
body:
Hello,

Ads appear every 2-3 actions in the free tier. This makes the app nearly unusable without paying. Excessive.

Regards

subject: App Uses Too Much Storage
body:
Hi,

The app uses 600MB on my phone. Far too much. Please add a 'Clear Cache' option in settings or reduce the storage footprint.

Thanks

subject: No Refund for Cancelled Subscription
body:
Hello,

I cancelled my annual subscription mid-year and was told I would not receive a refund for unused months. This is against consumer protection rules in my country. I expect a pro-rata refund.

Regards

subject: Quick Question About Storage Limits
body:
Hi,

I'm a free user — what is the storage limit before I need to upgrade? Can't find this information in the app. Also, love the app — very well designed!
Thanks

subject: Feature Request: Dark Mode Support
body:
Hello,

I love the app but really need dark mode. Use it late at night and the bright white is hard on my eyes. Many apps have this now.

Laura

subject: Request: Export to PDF Functionality
body:
Hi Team,

Exporting task lists and notes as PDF directly from the app would be incredibly useful. I share progress reports with my manager and currently copy everything manually.

A simple export button would save 30 mins/week.

subject: Suggestion: Biometric Login
body:
Hello,

Face ID / fingerprint login support would improve daily usability. Typing my long password every time is inconvenient, especially on mobile.
Thanks

subject: Suggestion for Improvement: Calendar Integration
body:
Hi,

Calendar integration (Google/Apple) would make this app a complete productivity solution. Currently switch between two apps to manage tasks and calendar. Even a read-only calendar view would be great.

Best regards

subject: Feature Request: Team Collaboration
body:
Dear Team,

Our company is evaluating the app for enterprise use. One key missing feature is real-time collaboration — multiple users editing the same project simultaneously. This is a deal-breaker for us.

Enterprise Team

subject: Feedback: Offline Mode Would Be Great
body:
Hello,

I travel frequently and often have no internet. Full offline mode with sync when back online would make this perfect for frequent travelers.

Thanks

subject: Request: Apple Watch App
body:
Hello,

An Apple Watch companion app would be a great addition. Checking and ticking off tasks from my wrist would save a lot of time.

Thank you

subject: Suggestion: Custom Themes
body:
Hi Team,

Custom color themes beyond light/dark would let users personalise the experience. Custom accent colors would be a nice touch.

Keep up the work!

subject: Love the New Dashboard Design!
body:
Hi Team,

The new dashboard in v3.1.0 is absolutely beautiful. The redesign made everything so much more intuitive. Great work by your design team!

Thanks!

subject: Outstanding App — Highly Recommend
body:
Hello,

Been using the app for 18 months and it keeps getting better. v3.0.1 was especially impressive. Performance improvements are noticeable.

Best

subject: Great Customer Support Experience
body:
Hi,

Had a billing issue last week and your support team resolved it within 2 hours. Exceptional service. The rep (Alex) was courteous and efficient.

Kind regards

subject: App Has Transformed My Productivity
body:
Hi,

This app has genuinely changed how I work. Used to miss deadlines and feel overwhelmed. After 6 months with your app, I'm on top of everything.

Thank you!

subject: Impressed by the Accessibility Features
body:
Hello Team,

As someone with low vision, thank you for excellent accessibility support. Dynamic text sizing and VoiceOver work flawlessly.

Keep it up!
